de1.P1.C1.ly_do: 0x + 0y = 6 khong phai phuong trinh bac nhat hai an (ca hai he so cua x, y deu bang 0); cac phuong an con lai deu la phuong trinh bac nhat hai an. Dap an B dung.

de1.P1.C2.ly_do: He A co phuong trinh 2x - y^2 = 12 (bac hai theo y) nen khong phai he phuong trinh bac nhat hai an; cac he con lai deu bac nhat. Dap an A dung.

de1.P1.C4.ly_do: x khong am nghia la x >= 0. Dap an D dung.

de1.P1.C5.ly_do: Chi co 3x < 0 la bat phuong trinh bac nhat mot an (0x < 0 he so bang 0; x^2 + 1 > 0 bac hai; 2 - x^3 < 0 bac ba). Dap an B dung.

de1.P1.C6.ly_do: Thu x = 2: A cho 9 > 9 sai; B cho -10 > 9 sai; C cho 2 - 4 = -2 < -4 + 4 = 0 dung; D cho -4 > 3 sai. Dap an C dung.

de1.P1.C7.ly_do: Tam giac MNP vuong tai M nen tan goc N = canh doi / canh ke = MP / MN. Dap an D dung.

de1.P1.C8.ly_do: Tam giac ABC vuong tai A co AB = 4, BC = 5 nen cos B = canh ke / canh huyen = AB / BC = 4/5. Dap an C dung.

de1.P1.C3.ghi_chu: Phuong an A (a < b) va D (b < a) la cung mot khang dinh nen co hai phuong an cung dung (voi a > 2,5 va b < 2,5 thi b < a). Kho chon D. Nho thay sua mot phuong an o ban de goc.
